work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Independent letter IV retains its named address to Bernard Collier, appointment as Mauritius apostolic vicar, mandate and complete closing. The numbered source citation at LF940 belongs to IV, not the following Shrewsbury letter. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF850–850; the source closing at LF905–908 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima quarta februarii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
